item.title: Brimstone: ES2025 JavaScript engine written in Rust
item.description:
📝 Brimstone Brimstone is a JavaScript engine written from scratch in Rust, aiming to have full support for the JavaScript language. Brimstone chooses to implement almost all components of the engine from scratch with minimal dependencies, with the notable exception of ICU4X. cargo build to build the bs executable cargo run to run from source JavaScript files can be executed with bs: # Build brimstone cargo build # Execute a JavaScript file.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/Hans-Halverson/brimstone

item.title: Garbage Collection Is Useful
item.description:

When the text document is edited, it produces a new tree which shares a bunch of nodes with the previous one. Intuitively, the difference is that tracing operates on live objects, or “matter”, while reference counting operates on dead objects, or “anti-matter”.
